title: When Does Sharing Work? Scaling a Shared SigLIP2 Across Image, Video, Audio, and Audio-Visual Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.05406v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Contrastive pretraining has advanced image-text understanding, yet image, video, and audio encoders are still trained independently, with cross-modal alignment realized mainly through post-hoc binding to a frozen anchor space. We present Omni-Encoder, a general multimodal encoder that processes image, video, audio, and audio-visual inputs within a single SigLIP-2 Vision Transformer with fully shared parameters. Unlike anchor-centric binding or per-modality adapters, all modalities are optimized jointly end-to-end, and the framework is organized from input to training. A modality-native input stage first maps each signal into the shared embedding space, including a 1D-convolutional audio tokenizer that converts mel-spectrograms into tokens aligned with visual patches. A multimodal rotary position embedding parameterized by absolute timestamps then places visual frames and audio segments in a unified spatiotemporal coordinate system. Fin

translated_title: 何时共享才有效？在图像、视频、音频与视听表征间扩展共享的SigLIP2
translated_abstract: 对比预训练已经推动了图像-文本理解的发展，然而图像、视频和音频编码器仍然是独立训练的，跨模态对齐主要通过事后绑定到冻结的锚点空间来实现。我们提出了Omni-Encoder，这是一个通用的多模态编码器，能够在单个SigLIP-2视觉Transformer中以完全共享的参数处理图像、视频、音频和视听输入。与以锚点为中心的绑定或针对每个模态的适配器不同，所有模态都以端到端的方式联合优化，且该框架从输入到训练进行了系统性组织。模态原生的输入阶段首先将每种信号映射到共享嵌入空间，其中包括一个一维卷积音频分词器，它将梅尔频谱图转换为与视觉patch对齐的token。随后，由绝对时间戳参数化的多模态旋转位置嵌入将视觉帧和音频片段置于统一的时空坐标系中。
tldr: 该论文提出Omni-Encoder，通过全参数共享的单一SigLIP-2 Transformer进行端到端联合训练，并借助一维卷积音频分词器和基于绝对时间戳参数化的多模态旋转位置嵌入，首次将图像、视频、音频和视听输入统一编码到共享的时空表征空间中。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Omni-Encoder, which unifies image, video, audio, and audio-visual inputs in a single fully-shared SigLIP-2 Transformer trained end-to-end, using a 1D-convolutional audio tokenizer and a timestamp-parameterized multimodal rotary position embedding to place all modalities in a unified spatiotemporal representation space.
